name: Grinning Gus
bio: Lost his face somewhere in the trenches and kept the grin. Still salutes anyone with a higher rank, or a pulse.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A zombie soldier with a bare skull (dark metal in the download; only its colour is kept here) and red eyes, a plate carrier and torn trousers.
